flavor: A massive, brass-toothed gear hangs suspended in the center of the chamber, rotating with a rhythmic, heartbeat-like thrum. Around its base, dozens of silver wedding bands and iron shackles lie scattered in the dust, all vibrating in perfect unison with the machine.
name: The Chronometer of Unspoken Vows
reason: The central gear acts as a focal point for a localized temporal anomaly, drawing in objects of significant emotional weight.
